read.loading: Reading what the customer was asked…
read.failed: What the customer was asked could not be read.
read.offline: Offline: what the customer was asked is read again once the connection is back.

held.noRight: Needs the right to override for customers (a production manager’s or an admin’s).
held.ownWord: A {kind} is the customer’s own word: nobody decides it for them or reverses their answer.
held.pending: A second person is asked already: see it in Home › Approvals.
held.answered: Answered already: reverse the answer instead.
held.notOpen: Withdrawn or expired: there is nothing to decide. Ask them again first.
held.notYours: Someone else decides it for the customer: you asked them for it, or your right does not reach this customer.
held.reversed: Reversed already: an answer is reversed once.
held.notAnswered: There is no answer to reverse yet.
held.noReach: Your right to override does not reach this customer.
held.reason: Say why, in words the customer reads.

pending.DECIDE_FOR: A decision for {customer} waits for a second person.
pending.REVERSE: Reversing {customer}’s answer waits for a second person.

done.decided: Decided for {customer}: they read why, and their task to answer is gone.
done.reversed: {customer}’s answer is reversed: they read why.
done.secondPerson: A second person is asked: it is done once a colleague grants it in Home › Approvals.
done.copyFailed: The link could not be copied: select it and copy it.
done.linkOnce: {customer} answers outside its portal: pass this link on. It is shown only now.

effect.ROUND_UNDER_REVIEW: The sample round is back under review.
effect.GATE_WAITING: The gate it passed waits again.
effect.ASK_AGAIN: The new date stands: the customer is asked again.
effect.MARK_ONLY: The answer stays, marked as reversed.
effect.other: The answer is marked as reversed.

decide.title: Decide for {customer}
decide.body: We record the answer in {customer}’s place. They are told at once with your reason, signed with our company’s name — never who of us.
decide.reasonHint: {customer} reads it: “Decided by us for you: …” (at most {max} characters).
decide.typedNameHint: Kept in our records; {customer} reads our company’s name.
decide.stepUp: A fresh code from your authenticator app is asked before it is done.
decide.secondPerson: When this customer needs a second person (its limits card), a colleague grants it in Home › Approvals first.

held.typedName: Type your full name to sign.

hint.APPROVED: As it stands: what follows from their yes goes ahead.
hint.APPROVED_WITH_CHANGES: Yes, with the changes you write: {customer} reads them.

reverse.title: Reverse {customer}’s answer
reverse.body: Their answer is kept and marked as reversed; {customer} reads why. It is refused in words when the effect cannot be undone (for example once cutting started).

what.SampleRound: The sample round goes back under review, and a gate it passed waits again.
what.REPROMISE: The new date stands: {customer} is asked again.
what.COUNTER_OFFER: Our counter-offer no longer stands (refused once it was carried out): refuse or answer their request again.
what.other: The answer stays, marked as reversed.

reverse.reasonHint: {customer} reads it: “Put back by us: …” (at most {max} characters).

refusal.OWN_WORD: It is the customer’s own word: nobody decides it for them or reverses their answer.
refusal.NOT_OPEN: It is withdrawn or expired: there is nothing to decide.
refusal.ANSWERED: The customer answered meanwhile: reverse the answer instead.
refusal.OWN_ASK: You asked the customer for this approval: someone else decides it for them.
refusal.NOT_ANSWERED: There is no answer to reverse.
refusal.PENDING: What we do for the customer here waits for a second person already: see it in Home › Approvals.
refusal.HELD: The record moved on since it was asked (decided another way, a newer revision, or cancelled): read it again.
refusal.NO_APPROVER: This customer needs a second person, and no office role may grant it: give a role the right to override for customers and to decide approvals, or switch the second person off on its limits card.
refusal.CUT: Cutting started on the lines it is about: it can no longer be reversed.
refusal.LEATHER_CUT: The leather for the lines it is about was cut: it can no longer be reversed.
refusal.APPLIED: Our counter-offer was carried out already: it can no longer be reversed.
refusal.other: It was refused as it stands.
refusal.stale: It changed since you read it: it has been read again.
refusal.forbidden: Your role does not allow it for this customer.
refusal.notFound: It is not there any more.
refusal.stepUp: It needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
refusal.unavailable: The factory service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
refusal.failed: It could not be done. Try again.

field.decision: Pick a decision this kind allows.
field.answer: Say what should change, or why it is refused.
field.reason: Say why, in words the customer reads.
field.typedName: Type your full name to sign.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your authenticator app
stepUp.sentence: Deciding for {customer}, or reversing its answer, needs a fresh code.

problem.wrong: That code was not accepted. Type the newest code.
problem.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked. Try again.
